creator.name: Arun Prabhudesai
creator.bio: User-supplied creator persona (preferences, not verified audience analytics): Arun Prabhudesai, Pune, India. Founder of Trakin Tech; experienced technology entrepreneur and creator covering smartphones, gadgets and tech industry news. Goal: simplify complex technology so everyday consumers and enthusiasts make confident purchase decisions. Audience: India, mixed technical familiarity, enthusiasts and mainstream shoppers. Voice: friendly, analytical, authoritative and conversational, with bold, high-stakes opening claims. Caption preference: standard English captions; preserve actual source languages independently. Platforms: YouTube, Shorts, Instagram, X and Facebook. Formats: talking-head breakdowns, hardware reviews, curated listicles, tutorials and shorts. Main videos: 5–15 minutes, plus short vertical content. Priorities: actionable advice on who should or should not buy; explain specifications through everyday utility; remain fair, objective and grounded in data; open with decisive, energetic hooks.
